question: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Aditya said, “He is the only son of my mother-in-law’s only daughter.” How is the boy related to Aditya?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

So,

 
• Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Aditya said, “He is the only son of my mother-in-law’s only daughter.” - It means Aditya's mother-in-law has only one daughter, thus Aditya is the husband of her daughter. And Aditya is the father of the boy as he is the son of his mother-in-law's daughter, who is his wife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0829e084266ba582252024773f4edd35f523142ecb1084167ebaedcda07a3116.png] ​

As, it is clear from the family tree that the boy is the son of Aditya.

Hence, "Son" is the correct answer.
